set.body: Provide one explicit installed replay journey from independently constructed source/recall through details, mapping, conditional fidelity and three views. Reuse existing stage validators/recordings; bind every stage to its actual preceding account; retain gaps and context/identity evidence. Compact Python and CLI surface without a new graph or provider engine. One source/two recalls plus native source path, independent adversarial checks, legacy compatibility and cold review.
set.title: P2/P3 connected recorded construction-to-analysis workflow
